title: A benchmark dataset for evaluating Syndrome Differentiation and Treatment in large language models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focused on evaluating Large Language Models on tasks related to Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), including Basic Knowledge, Medical Ethics, Content Safety, and Syndrome Differentiation and Treatment (SDT).
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the study.
